name: Mentalist AI Trend: Put Your Face on Patrick Jane in the Black-and-White Montage
blurb: The Mentalist AI trend puts your face on Patrick Jane, the smiling consultant from the TV series The Mentalist, in a black-and-white montage of his scenes: a sly look, a pointed finger, a wave from a camper van door and a big smile.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Replace the face of the main male character in the source video [Video 1], the man with wavy, swept-back hair in the dark three-piece suit who is in every shot, with my face from [Image 1]. [Image 1] shows the same person; use it to accurately preserve my identity.

Match my facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, and distinctive facial features: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo.

My face must remain recognizable and consistent throughout the entire video, including during head turns, speech, and fast movements, the quick cuts and the wide smile. Preserve the original character's body, clothing, actions, head movements, gaze direction, and facial expressions. Keep the original camera movement, framing, background, other people, and editing unchanged. Use [Image 1] only as a facial identity reference; do not copy the clothes or background from the photo. Blend my face naturally into the scene with matching lighting, shadows, perspective, and motion blur. Preserve realistic skin texture and natural occlusions when objects or hands pass in front of the face. No identity drift, flickering, warped features, beauty filters, or visible face-swap seams. Never drift back to the original man's face: NO wavy swept-back fair hair, NO stubble and NO deep smile lines unless [Image 1] shows them. Black and white throughout. If [Image 1] shows an animal, that animal is in every shot in his place, with its own face, fur and markings.

THE SHOTS of [Video 1], same black-and-white TV-drama look, same times:
0.0-0.9 s: a dark wood-panelled room: I stand in the dark suit and look across the room.
0.9-1.7 s: at a table, in the striped shirt and open waistcoat: I lean forward and talk with a knowing look, one hand raised.
1.7-3.4 s: a busy office: I stand in the dark suit, then a closer shot as a woman passes in front; I look past her.
3.4-4.3 s: close-up: a small head tilt, a sly look, the start of a smirk. My face, large and sharp.
4.3-5.0 s: I hold a cup of tea at the chest and smile.
5.0-5.8 s: seated in a grey jacket, I point a finger off camera with a smirk.
5.8-6.6 s: on a lawn, in the waistcoat and white shirt, I turn and look.
6.6-7.5 s: I lean out of a camper van door and wave.
7.5-8.4 s: close-up in a doorway: a big, warm smile, eyes squeezed shut. My face.
8.4-9.1 s: outside at night, a glass in one hand, I gesture and grin.
9.1-9.9 s: a dim room with wall lamps: I fix the jacket and look at the camera.

The woman in the office keeps her own face. Anatomy: one head only, two hands with five fingers each. No color, no text, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same black-and-white 2000s TV-drama look with soft grain, the same rooms and places, the same camera angles, cuts, timing and moves. The ONLY change: the man with wavy, swept-back hair in the dark three-piece suit, who is in every shot, is now the pet in [Image 1].

The lead = the pet in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: the same species and breed, head shape, face, eyes, ears, muzzle, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner knows it at once, also in the quick cuts. Whether [Image 1] shows a dog, a cat or another animal, it stays that animal. It sits or stands upright like a person in the man's place, its head where his head is and as large in the frame, so the close-ups are big, sharp close-ups of the pet's face. Only the head, the face, the ears, the fur and the paws change: the pet wears the open-collar shirt, the dark waistcoat and the dark suit jacket from [Video 1], sized to its own body. NO human face, NO human skin, NO human hair, NO stubble and NO human hands: its own furry face and front paws. Black and white throughout, in the same light and shadow as [Video 1].

THE SHOTS, at the same times as [Video 1]:
0.0-0.9 s: a dark wood-panelled room with a carved pillar: the pet stands upright in the dark suit and looks across the room.
0.9-1.7 s: at a table with a bottle, in the striped shirt and the open waistcoat: the pet leans forward with a knowing look, one front paw raised.
1.7-3.4 s: a busy office with desks and a small decorated tree: the pet stands in the dark suit, then a closer shot as a woman passes in the foreground; it looks past her with a calm stare.
3.4-4.3 s: a close-up: a small head tilt, half-closed eyes and a smug, knowing look. The face is large and sharp: exactly the pet from [Image 1].
4.3-5.0 s: the pet holds a cup of tea between its front paws at the chest, pleased.
5.0-5.8 s: seated in a grey jacket, it points one front paw at someone off camera with a smug look.
5.8-6.6 s: outside on a lawn, in the waistcoat and the white shirt, it turns its head and looks.
6.6-7.5 s: it leans out of the open door of a camper van and gives a small wave with one front paw.
7.5-8.4 s: a close-up in a doorway: a big, happy face with the eyes squeezed shut. Exactly the pet from [Image 1].
8.4-9.1 s: outside at night by dark leaves, it raises one front paw as if making a point, looking pleased.
9.1-9.9 s: a dim room with wall lamps and tall glass jars: it stands in the dark suit and the waistcoat, tugs the jacket with a paw and looks at the camera.

The woman in the office stays as in [Video 1] and never turns into the pet.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the pet's own shoulders, one muzzle, natural teeth and tongue. Animal front paws, never human hands. No extra animals. No color, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
